decisions.reason: The organic sliced salami platter is a flagship line that fits the firm's strategic push into organic and has stayed on the website for two years.
The premium sharing snack line has several variants and was extended with a poultry version in 2024, though its move from a page of its own to a mere mention suggests slightly less prominence.
The organic Fleischwurst is a core German staple in organic quality and was newly launched with its own page, so it is unlikely to be dropped this quickly.
The organic thin-sliced chicken breast line with several variants supports the organic and new-format expansion and is still early in its life cycle.
The herb-coated organic salami is a niche variant that could be pruned, as happened to the organic poultry mini salami snacks, but it is too new to drop yet.
